title: Buttery Allspice Delight Muffin
description: A sweet and savory muffin, perfect for breakfast or snack time. The combination of butter and allspice creates a warm and comforting flavor.
instructions: Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
In a large bowl, cream together butter and egg until light and fluffy.
Add the allspice and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the delight (flour) and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow muffins to cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
